thread:
Maya: Thanks for everyone who joined today's all-hands. Recording + slides: https://redwood.example/ah/nov-2026-recording and https://redwood.example/ah/nov-2026-slides. Leaving a short action summary.

Quinn: Heads-up: leadership bumped Dedicated GA to 2026-12-08 to give more time for autoscaler edge cases. Internal canaries targeted for 2026-11-22.

Ravi: Runtime notes: improved KV eviction heuristic merged to main. Still validating p99 under long-context workloads. I'll open a short RFC with bench results.

Sam: Infra will provision canary capacity and add queue-latency alarms. Ticket created: https://go.redwood/tickets/INF-900. Runbook stub: https://runbooks.redwood.example/dedicated-ga.

Leah: Customer ops will prepare migration one-pager + sample config snippets. Need a confirmed list of supported tokenizer versions from runtime.

ops-bot: Feature-flag state: "dedicated-int8" = off in prod. Toggle requires 2 approvals and a runbook entry. See https://go.redwood/ff-proc.

Maya: Action owners & due dates:
- Ravi: RFC + perf PR by Mon (2367960000)
- Sam: infra tickets + dashboards by Wed (2368140000)
- Leah: comms + one-pager by Thu EOD (2368220000)
Please create Asana tasks and paste links here.

Quinn: Security ask: KMS key rotation notes and customer key import instructions need to be finalized before GA. Security team?

security-bot: Security checklist stub posted: https://go.redwood/security/dedicated-ga-checklist. Key rotation steps added, pending review.

Ravi: Small perf run snippet for volunteers:
```
./tools/perf --scenario=dedicated-longctx --concurrency=350 --duration=20m
```
Volunteers please add your handle to the perf doc.

Sam: Will share dashboard links once infra is provisioned. Also adding a short "what could break" section to the runbook.

Leah: I'll post the comms draft in #marketing-review and link it here when ready.

Maya: Quick ask from finance: include a short blurb about burst metering in the migration guide so sales has a standard paragraph. Finance contact: finance@redwood.example

Quinn: Please add a 1-line rollback plan in each PR (toggle flag off + revert runtime image + run smoke tests).

Ravi: Example rollback commands:
```
kubectl set image deploy/runtime-canary runtime-image=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v1.10.5
./tools/ff toggle dedicated-int8 off --env=prod --approvers=2
```

Maya: Thanks  I'll run a 20-min sync tomorrow morning to check progress. If anything blocks, DM me.

Sam: noted.

Leah: Draft in marketing-review in ~24h.

ops-bot: Scheduled: perf-report-gen -> next run 2026-11-10T03:00Z."
